nativeBaseline.reference: authored semantic HTML with CSS-only Flow and AutoGrid arrangement recipes

library: apply a stable layout algorithm without changing authored semantic elements, roles, or DOM order
preserve token-based spacing, intrinsic reflow and logical layout in LTR and RTL
consumer: author meaningful landmarks, headings, names and native form-field relationships
prevent inaccessible overflow, control grouping confusion and focus order changes in application composition

notes: This is an accessibility obligation mapping for CSS-only layout recipes, not a conformance or independent review sign-off.
Layout creates no role, group, selection, keyboard model, or focus manager; interactive children retain their own accessibility contracts.
Independent visual/QA acceptance for the 2026-11-19 layout migration is tracked in GitHub issue #1418.
